newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CSR sees partial franking continuing.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CSR sees partial franking continuing.

text.p: Building products, sugar and aluminium group CSR Ltd said on Monday it expects further dividend payments to be only partially franked due to the continued rise of its earnings coming from offshore.

"This dividend that has just been announced is a partially franked dividend and our expectation is that the next few dividends will be partiallly franked," CSR executive director of finance and investment, Alec Brennan, told reporters.
CSR earlier announced it would pay a final dividend of nine cents for the second half of the year to March 31, 1997, taking the year dividend to 21 cents, down from 29 cents last year.
CSR said the final dividend would be 50 percent franked.
